quality_bar: TypeScript strict on Node >=20; vitest + tsc --noEmit must stay green and fast; everything boots in-process with the bundled Fastify REST backend (no network, Docker, or accounts in tests). MIT, publication-safe (generic identifiers, no machine paths).
